nodes.label: openrouteservice routing
nodes.rationale: A real API key and live end-to-end request are still needed before live routing can be marked complete.

nodes.label: Property-carrier HOS assumptions
nodes.rationale: The assessed flow assumes a property-carrying driver, a 70-hour/8-day cycle, no adverse conditions, and visible service and fueling defaults.

nodes.label: Event-driven HOS scheduler
nodes.rationale: Use an event-driven loop and earliest-boundary processing instead of minute-by-minute simulation.

nodes.label: Home-terminal midnight log split
nodes.rationale: Split events at home-terminal midnight without resetting HOS counters.

nodes.label: Visible planning assumptions
nodes.rationale: The required inputs omit complete duty history, so conservative defaults are made visible and included in the API response and README.

nodes.label: Aggregate cycle history limitation
nodes.rationale: Aggregate cycle usage cannot reconstruct daily recap credits, so a 34-hour restart is used instead of inventing historical expiry.

nodes.label: Initial scope boundary
nodes.rationale: Deliver assessed trip planning and log features before accounts, saved trips, certified ELD integrations, optimization, or verified facility search.

nodes.label: Conservative cycle policy
nodes.rationale: Do not invent recap credits; insert a 34-hour restart when further driving is blocked.
